neighbours.label: bodily movement of jumping, leaping, bending or tilting (and landing from a height)
fire: During the dance class I jumped and my partner was supposed to catch me.
Teenagers leap ten feet from the rooftops in those parkour videos.
Avoid bending forward or twisting your back when lifting boxes.
Tilt your head slightly back and look at the ceiling.
He landed hard on his heels after hopping down from the ladder.
The cat crouched and sprang onto the top of the bookshelf.
Squatting and kneeling put extra strain on the injured knee.
She vaulted over the fence and rolled onto the grass.
quiet: During the dance class I listened while my partner explained the steps.
Teenagers post ten videos a day about their favourite games.
Avoid lifting boxes that weigh more than twenty kilograms.
Look at the ceiling and notice the old wooden beams.
He paid for the ladder and drove home from the store.
The cat slept all afternoon next to the bookshelf.
Rest and ice help reduce swelling in the injured knee.
She painted the fence white and planted roses on the grass.
